usage: This is the standard, all-purpose word for 'congratulations' in Moroccan Darija. It is used for weddings, graduations, new purchases, and holidays. It is suitable for all formalities and can be said to anyone regardless of age or status.

variants.label: to a single person
variants.note: Adds a personal touch when congratulating an individual.

variants.label: to a group or couple
variants.note: Used when congratulating multiple people, like newlyweds.

variants.label: enthusiastic
variants.note: Used for major life events like weddings or buying a house to express strong joy.

examples.arabic: أَلْف مَبْرُوك الزّْوَاج، اللّٰه يْكَمَّل بِخِير.
examples.transliteration: alf mabrouk zwaaj, allah ikemmel bikhir.
examples.english: A thousand congratulations on the wedding, may God complete it well.
